title: contract-report/v1 extension block
description: Companion schema for spec/contract-report-v1.md. Validates the value of a Bundle's extensions["contract-report/v1"] member: a closed empty object, the producer's opt-in to the contract-report view of a verified Evidence Result. It carries no words, data, grouping, flags or provenance; a renderer takes its words from its wording pack and everything it shows from the sealed Result. A block this schema rejects is declined: the kind is not engaged (spec/contract-report-v1.md section 1). Where this schema and the document disagree, the document governs.
